title: The AI Hype Index: AI is everywhere
summary: Like a nasty rash, AI seems to spread everywhere. Google crams AI Overviews down your throat even though it costs the company billions of dollars in lost ad revenue. Leave your apartment, and you might pass two people heaving an AI-powered humanoid robot up the stairs to clean someone’s rooms. Go to the supermarket, and…
llm_summary: The piece paints AI as an omnipresent buzzword that’s being force‑fed to consumers—from Google’s costly “AI Overviews” that cannibalize its ad business to humanoid robots lugged up apartment stairs for cleaning, and AI‑driven gadgets crowding supermarket aisles. It argues that while the hype makes AI feel as unavoidable as a rash, many of these deployments are more marketing spectacle than genuine value.
